sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Archwarder's Amulet was given to Rassimov by the Professor ahead of his plan to attack Dante Vale's house. Rassimov then invoked him during the battle between the Professor, Dante, and Lok Lambert, in order to disrupt Tao and Behemoth, making them impossible to invoke. [The Secret of Two Generations] When the team raided the Professor's castle, Rassimov pretended to lose in combat against Dante Vale so that the Amulet of Archwarder could be picked up by Dante. [The Divine Comedy]

In line with Rassimov's intentions, Archwarder was then used by Dante against Overlos to allow the Puppeteer ability of Dendras to overpower the Professor's control of the Titan of Immortality. These actions led to the defeat of the Professor as well as a weakening in the influence and power of the Organization. [The Mission]

During a later battle in Klaus' laboratory upon the discovery of the Amulet of the Nullifier, Void, Dante used Archwarder to disrupt the Blood Spiral Titan Shakrit. However, the newly-returned Rassimov callously used Darkvoid to destroy Archwarder and his Amulet. [The Blood Spiral]

Archwarder has an attack power of 3 and a defense power of 3. [LGS-094]. His Disruption Pulse ability makes opposing Seekers lose control of high powered Titans. The more powerful the opposing Titan, the more susceptible it is to the ability. This can be manifested as an energy wave emitting in all directions, making it so when it comes into contact with the Amulet of a Titan, the Titan and its amulet to surge with energy and for the Seeker to lose its control [The Mission]; however, the surge of energy can also be more focused and be targeted at either the Titan itself [The Blood Spiral] or its amulet (preventing the Titan from being summoned in the first place) [The Secret of Two Generations], emerging either through Archwarder's hands or mouth.

*Archwarder's summoning commands are "'''Feed and grow'''", "'''Turn the tide'''" and "'''Go'''".
*Despite his plant-based design, Archwarder is not a [[Gaia-Titan]].
*With the exception of [[Void]] who is a [[Nullifier]], Archwarder is the only known [[Titan]] used by [[Rassimov]] that is not a [[Hecto-Titan]]. 
*Archwarder appears in [[Iginio Straffi]]'s other series ''[[w:c:winx|Winx Club]]'' in episode 418, "[[w:c:winx:Winx Club - Episode 418|The Nature Rage]]." They are creatures created by Diana to terrorize Gardenia.

full_text:
Archwarder resembles a plant with a giant, wilted, bloomed flower and three strong roots as legs. It is the ultimate defense against the Legendary Titans, as this plant-based Titan is able to counter even the Legendary Titans' unique abilities and to level the playing field for Archwarder's Seeker.

==History ==
Archwarder's Amulet was given to Rassimov by the Professor ahead of his plan to attack Dante Vale's house. Rassimov then invoked him during the battle between the Professor, Dante, and Lok Lambert, in order to disrupt Tao and Behemoth, making them impossible to invoke. [The Secret of Two Generations] When the team raided the Professor's castle, Rassimov pretended to lose in combat against Dante Vale so that the Amulet of Archwarder could be picked up by Dante. [The Divine Comedy]

In line with Rassimov's intentions, Archwarder was then used by Dante against Overlos to allow the Puppeteer ability of Dendras to overpower the Professor's control of the Titan of Immortality. These actions led to the defeat of the Professor as well as a weakening in the influence and power of the Organization. [The Mission]
